coder_notes: 68Ga-PSMA is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it as the screening/selection diagnostic per the description, so it is listed as a diagnostic agent. PSMA uptake on PET is an imaging-based selection criterion and is not recorded as a molecular biomarker. Tumour PK coded yes because SPECT/CT dosimetry quantifies the absorbed dose to the tumour; this is imaging dosimetry rather than tissue concentration, so an adjudicator may prefer no.
